description: This file defines a class 'Random' in the PhpSpreadsheet library which provides static methods for generating random numbers, including functions similar to Excel's RAND, RANDBETWEEN, and RANDARRAY. It includes methods for simple random number generation, bounded random number generation, and array-based random number generation, supporting both decimal and integer outputs.

classes.name: Random
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for generating random numbers, akin to Excel functions, with support for array inputs.

methods.name: rand
methods.description: Returns a random float between 0 and 1 (exclusive), using mt_rand scaled down.

methods.name: randBetween
methods.description: Returns a random integer between specified min and max values, with error handling for invalid inputs or negative ranges.

methods.name: randArray
methods.description: Generates a 2D array of random numbers with specified dimensions, supports decimal and integer outputs, and handles parameter validation.
